task.title: Claim exact persisted recurrence occurrences
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/931 to add exact-revision durable reservation for one persisted recurrence coordinate.
acceptance_criteria: Claim one due coordinate at an inclusive caller cutoff and persist exact revision-bearing evidence.
Reject missing, stale, future, unavailable, and materialized coordinates without appending.
Preserve strict replay, race safety, historical inventory boundaries, and caller-owned authority.

attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the issue contract before completing the production boundary.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented recurrence.occurrence_claimed, exact lookup, revision-before-lifecycle and cutoff validation, strict replay, and one-winner concurrency semantics.
attempts.patch: Implemented the issue 931 contract in crates/vela-kernel/src/scheduler.rs with focused tests and synchronized architecture and behavior documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit found that tests did not pin revision-before-cutoff precedence; commit 5da22fe added the stale-revision plus future-cutoff regression, and final review found no further issues.
attempts.patch: Applied blocking findings where present, reran verification, required substantive review, and preserved zero unresolved review threads before merge.

outcome.summary: Issue 931 delivered the documented recurrence boundary with strict evidence, bounded authority, and verified merge provenance.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 932 exact head

lessons: Validation precedence is observable behavior and needs an explicit regression.
A claim is reservation evidence, not a lease or execution grant.
Caller-owned coordinate, revision, and cutoff keep clock and selection policy outside the store.
